_note: Link constants for perf_model/scaling.py. These are NOT measured in this repo: the only machine available has one GPU, so no NCCL all reduce could be timed. Bandwidth is the effective per GPU bus bandwidth a ring collective reaches (below the spec sheet rate). Replace with nccl-tests busbw numbers when a multi GPU machine is available.

nvlink._source: NVLink 4 class (900 GB/s total, 450 GB/s per direction per GPU), about 80% reached by NCCL ring all reduce

pcie._source: PCIe Gen5 x16 (64 GB/s per direction) for cards without NVLink or direct peer access, traffic staged through host memory

infiniband._source: one 400 Gb/s (NDR, 50 GB/s) NIC per GPU, about 90% reached

nvlink_ib._desc: data center style: 8 GPUs per node on NVLink, nodes on InfiniBand

pcie_ib._desc: 8 PCIe cards per node with no NVLink (like the sm_120 card used here), nodes on InfiniBand

_gpu_memory_note: memory of the GPU whose calibration is used (sm_120, 32 GB); configurations that exceed 90% of it are rejected
_activation_note: measured in milestone 5 on medium (d 1024, 24 layers) at seq 1024, bf16, SDPA: each extra sequence adds 1.76 GB of peak memory without activation checkpointing (1.76e9 / (24 x 1024 x 1024) = 70) and 0.49 GB with it (= 19.5)
